definitions.explanation: Describes a person or animal that follows instructions or authority without resistance. Can be used positively (well-behaved) or negatively (too submissive).

examples.japanese: この{犬|いぬ}はとても{従順|じゅうじゅん}だ。
{彼|かれ}は{上司|じょうし}に{従順|じゅうじゅん}な{態度|たいど}を{見|み}せた。
examples.english: He showed a submissive attitude toward his boss.

examples.japanese: {従順|じゅうじゅん}なだけでは{自分|じぶん}の{意見|いけん}を{伝|つた}えることができない。
examples.english: If you are only obedient, you cannot express your own opinions.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a な-adjective: {従順|じゅうじゅん}な{人|ひと} (an obedient person), {従順|じゅうじゅん}な{性格|せいかく} (a docile personality).

COMPOSITION:
{従|じゅう} (follow, obey) + {順|じゅん} (order, obedience).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {従順|じゅうじゅん}な{性格|せいかく} (a docile nature)
- {従順|じゅうじゅん}に{従|したが}う (to obey obediently)
- {従順|じゅうじゅん}な{態度|たいど} (a submissive attitude)
